name: rapidcam
description: Web-based parametric 2D vector editor — foundation for a CNC CAM program

scripts.lint: biome lint src test scripts cli mcp e2e
scripts.format: biome format --write src test scripts cli mcp e2e
scripts.//validate: Ends with `vite build`, not `npm run build`, so tsc runs once. Do NOT 'simplify' this the other two ways: stripping tsc from `build` would let a manual/host deploy ship type-broken code (CI only runs validate, so it would not notice), and dropping the separate typecheck would push type errors behind the 35s test run instead of surfacing them in 4s.
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && vite build
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate && npm run test:e2e
